title: Engine-free audio port contract — event -> sound mapping
notes: One entry per audio event the game can emit. An 'event' is a distinct sound a player can hear, not a source line: sfx.point(win) at js/game.js:2111 is one call site that emits two different sounds (point-win / point-loss), so it is two events sharing one anchor.
Every anchor.line is the line of the sfx call itself and must contain anchor.call verbatim. The test re-reads the source and fails if it does not.

port.eventIdAnchors are the message ids the ported sim actually stores in state.events / state.pointMessage at the cited godot/src/sim/sim.gd line, each with the function that must enclose it; an empty list means the port emits no event id at that trigger, which is recorded honestly rather than invented.
The 10 baked WAVs in tools/audio-audition/baked are the ground truth of the sound set; each is bound to exactly one event and carries the sha256 of the verified asset.

masterGainRange.anchor: index.html:426, index.html:603 (type=range min=0 max=1 step=0.01 value=0.5)

musicBusGain.scope: music only — no baked WAV in this contract is routed through the music bus

mute.gates: js/audio.js:24, :41, :157, :184, :202, :262 — every synth entry point returns early when muted; there is no per-sound mute

reducedMotion.anchor: js/audio.js — no occurrence of 'reduce'/'motion'; evidence docs/wayfinder/evidence/audio-port-route.md §'reduced-motion branch'

ducking.note: the reference defines no ducking, compressor, master limiter or fade; overlap is pure additive summation (point-win + victory + music can sum)

panning.note: no StereoPannerNode / 3D positioning anywhere in js/audio.js — the reference is mono-per-voice, no distance attenuation

unknowns: the reference never states a target loudness or headroom; only per-voice synth gains
no per-event runtime volume exists: each baked WAV already contains its synth gain (e.g. hit tone 0.4 at js/audio.js:62)
no definition of how two overlapping events should be prioritised if a Godot mixer ever needs to duck

events.trigger: a serve is struck: performServe() places the ball on its trajectory

synth.voices: noise 0.22s bandpass 600Hz gain 0.12 + sine 330->720Hz rising 0.18s gain 0.12
synth.perPlayRandomness: noise buffer is a fresh Math.random() draw (js/audio.js:45)

port.note: the ported perform_serve stores no event id at the strike; the nearest stored event is evServeValid (sim.gd:2091), which fires on the first valid bounce instead

events.trigger: a paddle successfully contacts the ball (every successful hit, including a special)

synth.perPlayRandomness: noise buffer is a fresh Math.random() draw (js/audio.js:45)

port.note: the port's hit_ball stores trajectory/quality events (evChiquita, evGlobo, evSlice, ...) but none at the raw contact point; sfx.hit has no port event-id counterpart

events.trigger: hitBall() runs with isSpecial=true (the energy-bar shot)

synth.voices: noise 0.3s bandpass 1400Hz gain 0.2 + sawtooth 1200->240Hz 0.3s gain 0.14 + sine 210->90Hz 0.3s gain 0.2
synth.perPlayRandomness: noise buffer is a fresh Math.random() draw (js/audio.js:45)

port.note: apply_special (sim.gd:1874) selects the message id by athlete id: maestro evPrecision (1884), pantera evLightningDash (1889), steamer evSteamSmash (1897), fiamma evSteamShield (1902), oracolo evPerfectVision (1909), colosso evSteamHammer (1915)

events.trigger: scorePoint() awards a point to the player and state.result is still null (match not over)

synth.note: baked as ONE sequence file because the stagger uses wall-clock setTimeout (js/audio.js:88)

port.note: the port stores the message id instead of the localized text: state.pointMessage = "pointYou" at sim.gd:2026, inside the state.result == null branch

events.trigger: scorePoint() awards a point to the AI and state.result is still null (match not over)

port.note: state.pointMessage = "pointOpp" at sim.gd:2026, same branch as point-win

events.trigger: scorePoint() with state.result set and winner === "player" (match won)

synth.note: baked as ONE sequence file; music is already stopped before this by js/main.js:1385

port.note: the port's score_point has no victory branch (the JS else-if was dropped with sfx); the nearest stored event id is setToYou at sim.gd:1947 in finish_set, and the authoritative port signal is state.result being set

events.trigger: scorePoint() with state.result set and winner === "ai" (match lost)

port.note: mirror of victory: no defeat branch survives in the port; nearest stored id is setToCircuit at sim.gd:1947

events.trigger: the ball rebounds off the court floor

synth.perPlayRandomness: none (the only fully deterministic one-shot besides point-loss)

port.note: the port stores no event at the raw rebound (the sfx call site itself stores none in JS either); the events it can store inside this function are evServeValid (sim.gd:2091, first valid service bounce) and evSmashValid (sim.gd:2115)

events.trigger: the ball contacts a wall (glass or side)

synth.voices: noise 0.16s bandpass 900Hz gain 0.32 + sine 92->54Hz 0.22s gain 0.4 (loudest low one-shot)
synth.perPlayRandomness: noise buffer is a fresh Math.random() draw (js/audio.js:45)

port.note: the only 1:1 audio counterpart in the port: JS stores addEvent(t("evWallValid")) at js/game.js:2365 right after the sfx call, and the port stores evWallValid at sim.gd:2242, gated by the same wallEventTimer cooldown

events.trigger: the ball touches the net (band or cord)

synth.voices: noise 0.06s bandpass 1600Hz gain 0.16 + triangle 310->170Hz 0.06s gain 0.18 (shortest burst in the game)
synth.perPlayRandomness: noise buffer is a fresh Math.random() draw (js/audio.js:45)

port.note: the port stores evTape (sim.gd:2273, band/tape contact) and evNetRebound (sim.gd:2284, full net rebound) inside the same function, after the same crossing/clearance test as the JS

notInContract.what: the 5 generative music voices (bass, pad, arp, kick, hat)
notInContract.why: they are not event-triggered and have no baked WAV in tools/audio-audition/baked (the bake wrote only the 10 one-shots); they are scheduling logic driven by rally intensity, owned by the audio-port-route ticket, not by an event->sound mapping

the reference has no variant concept — the variation is inside the noise buffer drawn per play (js/audio.js:45). How many variants a Godot player holds is a realisation choice (ticket audio-port-route, 4-6 variants), not an event-mapping fact
js/drill.js contains zero sfx call sites; the drill delegates all physics to updateMatch (js/drill.js:355) and therefore emits exactly the events above through the same sim

honestUnknowns: no Godot-side audio module exists: godot/src/sim/sim.gd:17 states sfx.* / emit* / updateFx / resetFx are deliberately not called, so nothing in this contract has ever been played by the engine
no engine playback, no mixer wiring, no AudioStreamPlayer / AudioStreamRandomizer tree exists; the mapping is data + source-verified anchors only
no volume-tuned numbers beyond the two reference defaults (master 0.5, music bus 0.55): the reference defines no target loudness, no headroom, no ducking

the port's event ids are strings (message ids), not numbers: state.gd:18-20 says events/pointMessage hold message ids; sim.gd add_event takes a String. There is no numeric event-id space in the port today, so the contract binds to the string ids that exist

which port event id, if any, should carry each sfx sound is a presentation-layer decision that does not exist yet; where the port stores no id at the trigger, this map records an empty list rather than inventing one
porting parity of overlaid events (hit + special played together) is asserted from source, not measured in the engine
